items.note: The prompt names Ms. Alvarez as the landlord and says to address her as Ms. Alvarez.
Apartment 4B is stated more than once.
It says the heater stopped working on October 2.
It says the problem was reported by phone on October 3 with no response.
It says overnight temperatures are in the 40s °F.
It asks for the repair to be completed within 48 hours.
Section 12 of the lease is listed among the facts, and the lease section is named as a specific detail to include.
It asks for a formal, polite and firm tone.
It says not to threaten anything and specifically not to mention withholding rent.
